attempts.sql: SELECT enclosing_class_symbol_id AS symbol_id, COUNT(*) AS method_count FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE is_method AND enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT in_test_file GROUP BY enclosing_class_symbol_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY method_count DESC, symbol_id ASC

request:
Which classes in the non-test code define at least 20 methods directly in their own body? Count every method definition separately (a property getter and its setter count as two; inherited methods and methods of nested classes do not count). Return each class's symbol ID and its method count, largest count first, ties broken by symbol ID alphabetically.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), method_count (integer). Order the rows as the question asks.
explanation: The class of each method is given by enclosing_class_symbol_id, which counts only methods defined directly in the class body (nested methods belong to their own class). Counting methods per class in non-test files and grouping by 20+ yields the requested classes with their counts.
sql: SELECT enclosing_class_symbol_id AS symbol_id, COUNT(*) AS method_count FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE is_method AND enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT in_test_file GROUP BY enclosing_class_symbol_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY method_count DESC, symbol_id ASC
